free_disk_preflight.estimate_note: Uses clean durations and uncompressed float32 WAVs; assumes every condition has clean-length cache arrays, including trimmed. It is conservative for trimmed clips.

debug_preflight.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 4.2.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2019 the FFmpeg developers
debug_preflight.total_estimate_method: Sum of measured wall times for each of six conditions on the identical first 500 fixed-manifest clips, scaled by 10,000/500 and a 25% safety margin plus 60 seconds for startup/reporting. Every timing includes source decode, the condition transform (including actual FFmpeg MP3 encode and decode), float-WAV persistence and hash/manifest I/O, separate CNN and SVM feature cache lookup/extraction/persistence, and batched inference. The first 20 clips per condition also include equivalence validation, making the timing conservative.
